![undopia-3d-doors](https://i.imgur.com/1nlAcdE.png) # Undopia 3D 門 [![Modrinth 下載數](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/undopia-3d-doors?style=for-the-badge&logo=modrinth&label=Modrinth&color=%231bd96a) ](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/undopia-3d-doors) [![CurseForge 下載數](https://img.shields.io/curseforge/dt/1110565?style=for-the-badge&logo=curseforge&label=CurseForge&color=%23f16436) ](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/undopia-3d-doors) [![ko-fi](https://i.imgur.com/wv1uE4k.png)](https://ko-fi.com/undugt) 3D Doors 為門與活板門提供三維模型、自訂側面紋理以及自訂物品模型。同時修正了舊版遊戲中門的旋轉問題。 ---
[![Undopia Patch 材質包](https://i.imgur.com/beZ50qS.png)](https://patch.undopia.net) 此材質包屬於 Undopia Patch 系列。 它由以下 Undopia Patch 功能組成 ![9MDlYrA.png](https://i.imgur.com/9MDlYrA.png) ![9tt2SEl.png](https://i.imgur.com/9tt2SEl.png) ![tiQTE7Z.png](https://i.imgur.com/tiQTE7Z.png) 如需自訂任何項目，請使用 Undopia Patch 客製化工具。
